title: Summer night low
description: Elhub summer low hour 2026-07-12T06:00:00+02:00: each price area's demand scaled to its metered total. Initial dispatch: wind and run-of-river hydro at their NVE normal-year mean output, storage hydro committed largest first to 70 % loading for the residual demand and shared in proportion to capacity; HVDC links and the Nordic exchange at 0 MW (no evidenced schedule). The Nordic remainder keeps the model's winter inertia and load; the Operating Point schema cannot override them.
